related.title: 齒輪滾齒與剃齒
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：環形近似標為上界，密度和齒形分別檢查，沒有用重量宣稱齒輪壽命。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Label the annular approximation as a bound, check density and tooth shape separately, and do not infer gear life from mass.
related.difference: 把模數、齒數與節圓關係算清，區分滾齒生成幾何與剃齒修整。
related.differenceEn: Calculate module, tooth count and pitch diameter, distinguishing generated geometry from shaving refinement.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 環形體積 V=π(Do²−Di²)b/4，質量 m=ρsolid×relative density×V；齒槽另扣。 合成等效環形外徑 60 mm、內徑 20 mm、寬 10 mm；實體密度 7.8 g/cm³，相對密度 0.90。 V=8π cm³=25.1327 cm³；m=7.8×0.90×8π=176.4318 g。模型尚未扣齒槽。
直齒輪節圓 d=mz，圓周節距 p=πm；節圓不是可直接卡尺量到的齒頂圓。 教學直齒輪模數 2 mm、齒數 30；標準未變位齒頂高暫取 1m。 節圓 d=60 mm，節距 p=6.28319 mm，齒頂圓 da=m(z+2)=64 mm。變位或非標準齒不適用最後一式。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Annular volume V=π(Do²−Di²)b/4 and m=ρ solid×relative density×V, with tooth spaces deducted separately. Synthetic equivalent annulus OD 60, ID 20, width 10 mm; solid density 7.8 g/cm³ and relative density 0.90. V=8 π cm³=25.1327 cm³; m=7.8×0.90×8 π=176.4318 g, before tooth-space subtraction.

For a spur gear d=mz and circular pitch p=πm; pitch circle is not the directly measurable outside circle. Teaching spur gear module 2 mm and 30 teeth; assume unshifted standard addendum 1 m. Pitch diameter 60 mm, circular pitch 6.28319 mm and OD=m(z+2)=64 mm; the last expression excludes profile shift/nonstandard teeth.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 機器人工作空間規劃
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：環形近似標為上界，密度和齒形分別檢查，沒有用重量宣稱齒輪壽命。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Label the annular approximation as a bound, check density and tooth shape separately, and do not infer gear life from mass.
related.difference: 辨認可達點、可達姿態與無碰撞路徑三種不同問題。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish reachable points, reachable poses and collision-free paths.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 環形體積 V=π(Do²−Di²)b/4，質量 m=ρsolid×relative density×V；齒槽另扣。 合成等效環形外徑 60 mm、內徑 20 mm、寬 10 mm；實體密度 7.8 g/cm³，相對密度 0.90。 V=8π cm³=25.1327 cm³；m=7.8×0.90×8π=176.4318 g。模型尚未扣齒槽。
平面雙連桿完整旋轉時，半徑範圍|L1−L2|到L1+L2，工作區為環形；真實限位與障礙會刪減。 教學L1=0.4 m、L2=0.3 m，暫不計工具長度與限位。 內半徑0.1 m、外半徑0.7 m；面積π(0.7²−0.1²)=1.507964 m²。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Annular volume V=π(Do²−Di²)b/4 and m=ρ solid×relative density×V, with tooth spaces deducted separately. Synthetic equivalent annulus OD 60, ID 20, width 10 mm; solid density 7.8 g/cm³ and relative density 0.90. V=8 π cm³=25.1327 cm³; m=7.8×0.90×8 π=176.4318 g, before tooth-space subtraction.

With full planar rotation, radius spans |L 1−L 2| to L 1+L 2, forming an annulus; limits and obstacles reduce it. Teaching L 1=0.4 m and L 2=0.3 m, omitting tool length and limits. Inner radius 0.1 m, outer radius 0.7 m; area π(0.7²−0.1²)=1.507964 m².
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
